exposure: GDM treatment method (dietary control vs. medication)
outcome: fetal cerebrovascular flow indices (vascularization index (VI), flow index (FI), vascularization flow index (VFI))
cohort: The study included 80 low-risk pregnancies and 80 pregnancies complicated by gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) at Rajavithi Hospital.
finding: Fetal cerebrovascular flow indices (FI and VFI) were significantly elevated in the GDM group compared to low-risk pregnancies, and GDM patients managed with dietary control had higher VFI than those treated with medication.
